body: P1, fixed. An independent read-only review (a fresh general-purpose subagent given the commits 99a4a80f..cc01fdb4 and the task file, not the worker's conclusions) found that uv colours each `uv tool list` tool line when FORCE_COLOR or CLICOLOR_FORCE is set, even when set to 0. herdr-agents exports both in every pane and workspace it creates (home/dot_local/bin/common/executable_herdr-agents:785, 927, 2243). The phase therefore read "\e[1mhcom" as a tool name, so every `uv tool upgrade` failed and no skip line was printed, which is worse than `--all`. The worker re-derived it: `FORCE_COLOR=1 uv tool list | od -c` starts with `033 [ 1 m h c o m`, and `--color never` prints plain text. Red in 7eb9438f: the fake uv colours tool lines under those variables unless it is given --color never, and the phase called `tool upgrade \x1b[1mhcom`. Fixed in 09414805: `uv tool list --color never`.

P3, declared. The awk reader takes any line ending in `.whl` inside the asset's block, not only `files:` URLs, and it does not check `source: https-download`. It misses a quoted URL, a URL followed by a comment or a trailing space, and a quoted pin, which would print with its quotes. The real manifest reads correctly, and test_the_repository_manifest_pins_hcom_from_a_wheel_at_the_rendered_pin pins that. A miss falls back to the old behaviour (an index upgrade that warns), never to a wrong skip of an index tool. In 09414805 the `shortcut:` comment names the limit: unquoted block style; use a parser if assets: gains quotes or flow style.

One review round on cc01fdb4: `Verdict: incorrect` on the P1 above, with no other P0 to P2 finding. It confirmed red on eedf0db9 (6 failures) and green on cc01fdb4 (9 tests), and the 15 `upgrade` tests of test_runtime_health.py pass. shellcheck, shfmt and ruff are clean. Caps 6, 31 and 147. update_omp needed no change: the dangling-link check comes after the checksum and before npm, one readlink line, a plain rm of one path, and a live link, file or directory untouched. Third note (P3, declared in report.md): `manifest_wheel_pin` is a helper beside `upgrade_uv_tools`, which the threat_table row's wording "only in upgrade_uv_tools" does not name; it is part of the uv phase and called only from it. After the fix round the worker re-ran the suite (9 tests and the 15 runtime-health upgrade tests green), shellcheck and shfmt; caps 6, 32 and 158. This is local process evidence, not the task-level audit or reviewer authentication.
